description: ignorePaths is spelled out because config:recommended's :ignoreModulesAndTests preset ignores **/test/**, and every fixture image and probe pin lives under test/. Left to the preset they are managed by nothing, so they drift behind the engine images' own base.

lockFileMaintenance is how transitive dependencies get updated at all. It has no release timestamp, so Renovate's minimumReleaseAge would keep it pending forever and is "0 days" there; pnpm applies the one in pnpm-workspace.yaml when it regenerates the lockfile.
lockFileMaintenance has its own default schedule, so it repeats the weekly one.

packageRules.description: Actions from the buildcage org are exempt from minimumReleaseAge and from the weekly schedule, so a new release lands right away.
@vitest/coverage-v8 and @vitest/expect must equal the vitest that vite-plus bundles, which Renovate cannot see, so pin them by hand when upgrading vite-plus instead of letting Renovate bump them.
CoreDNS still publishes its 2016-2017 tags v001 to v011, which Renovate ranks as majors 1 to 11, so only x.y.z releases are candidates.

buildcage-runc builds this fork through a replace. The fork also has upstream's tags, which semver ranks above the -buildcage.N prereleases, so only those are candidates. The tags are ours, so no release-age wait.
eclipse-temurin 17 is the JKS case of the Java tests, so it stays on 17.
